notes.title: The "Pink Noise" demo is ready for the Steam Next Fest!
The "Pink Noise" demo is available now!
notes.content:
Hello friends!

We are happy to announce that the long awaited "Pink Noise" demo is now available for download right here on Steam!

What awaits you is:
- Getting to know all the main characters of the story. 
- An exciting retro-style mini-game.
- The first choices hinting at the branching storylines of the full version of the game.
- The beginning of an intriguing story that will form the basis of further episodes.

We look forward to your feedback!
Your feedback is very important to us. We would love to hear your impressions, suggestions or bug reports.

Ready to dive into the world of nightmares? Download the demo now!

Stay tuned for news and updates on the full release.

Best wishes,
Somber Games.
